source.query: SELECT if((SELECT count() FROM (SELECT 1 FROM logs WHERE service_name = 'arena' AND timestamp <= now() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND LIMIT 1)) > 0, count(), NULL) AS value FROM (SELECT NULL AS _metric_value FROM logs WHERE service_name = 'arena' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 3600 SECOND AND attributes['event_type'] = 'game_completed') AS _source LIMIT 1
